nodes.name: events.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri event bridge that lets the frontend subscribe to live sync outbox-state changes instead of polling, emitting a SYNC_STATUS_EVENT payload to every webview whenever the worker finishes processing a push/merge/pull cycle.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a canonical OnceLock<AppHandle> pattern (set once at boot via init_emitter) shared with other native bridges in the codebase.

nodes.name: git_credentials.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves HTTPS Git credentials for clone/push/API calls by walking ADAPTER_GITHUB connection rows and returning the first usable HTTPS bearer token; SSH connections are intentionally skipped and fall back to system git config.

nodes.name: import.rs
nodes.summary: Owns the lifecycle of the import_progress table rows that track a per-(project, adapter) paginated historical-import walk, providing state transition helpers (ensure_pending, advance, mark_completed/failed/cancelled, reset_for_retry) and the worker's runnable-row scheduler query.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for outbox CRUD against projects.db; opens the shared DB connection via conn() and re-exports the full read/write API surface from sibling read.rs and write.rs modules.

nodes.name: read.rs
nodes.summary: Read-only SQL query layer over outbox_entries, sync cursors, adapter bindings, and import-problem rows against projects.db, plus the plain data types (SyncCursor, AdapterBinding, ProjectBinding) that model the read surface.

nodes.name: write.rs
nodes.summary: Mutation layer (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) over outbox_entries and project sync columns in projects.db, centered on an atomic claim-next-pending-row UPDATE that avoids a race window between concurrent worker ticks.
nodes.languageNotes: The atomic claim uses a single conditional UPDATE (WHERE id=? AND status='pending') rather than SELECT-then-UPDATE to avoid TOCTOU races across worker ticks.

nodes.name: SyncEventTrigger
nodes.summary: Enum of what triggered a sync-status emission: PushCycle, PullCycle, MergeCycle, or Manual.

nodes.name: SyncStatusEvent
nodes.summary: Serializable payload broadcast to the frontend on the SYNC_STATUS_EVENT channel, snapshotting a project's outbox pending/failed/abandoned counts and last error.

nodes.name: init_emitter
nodes.summary: Stores the Tauri AppHandle once at app boot so later emit_status calls can broadcast to webviews.

nodes.name: build_event
nodes.summary: Reads the current outbox snapshot for a project from the DB and assembles it into a SyncStatusEvent payload.

nodes.name: emit_status
nodes.summary: Builds a SyncStatusEvent for a project and emits it to every webview; silently no-ops if the AppHandle hasn't been initialized yet.

nodes.name: GitCredential
nodes.summary: Resolved HTTPS credential bundle (connection id, username, token, source) usable for git clone/push or GitHub API calls.

nodes.name: find_https_credential
nodes.summary: Walks ADAPTER_GITHUB connection rows and returns the first one whose stored token can serve as an HTTPS bearer credential.

nodes.name: git_credential_for_remote
nodes.summary: Public entry point that resolves the HTTPS credential to use for a given git remote URL.

nodes.name: ImportProgressRow
nodes.summary: One row of the import_progress table: cursor, imported count, total hint, and timestamps for a project's paginated historical import.

nodes.name: ensure_pending
nodes.summary: Creates the import_progress row on adapter attach; no-ops if one already exists (including terminal rows) so re-attach doesn't re-trigger a full import.

nodes.name: read_status
nodes.summary: Reads the current import_progress row for a project, used by the UI status panel.

nodes.name: advance
nodes.summary: Bumps the page cursor and imported-item counter after a page has been applied.

nodes.name: mark_completed
nodes.summary: Marks an import_progress row terminal-completed.

nodes.name: mark_failed
nodes.summary: Marks an import_progress row terminal-failed with an error message.

nodes.name: mark_cancelled
nodes.summary: Marks an import_progress row terminal-cancelled.

nodes.name: reset_for_retry
nodes.summary: Resets a failed/cancelled import_progress row back to pending so the worker will pick it up again.

nodes.name: list_runnable
nodes.summary: Worker scheduler query: returns import_progress rows in pending/running state that are due for another page fetch.

nodes.name: conn
nodes.summary: Opens a fresh connection to projects.db, initializing project tables first when compiled for tests.

nodes.name: SyncCursor
nodes.summary: Per-project pull cursor persisted between pull cycles so adapters can request only changes since last_pull_at.

nodes.name: AdapterBinding
nodes.summary: The adapter_id/config/connection tuple bound to a project for sync.

nodes.name: ProjectBinding
nodes.summary: A project's full sync binding: slug, adapter, config, connection, and last webhook timestamp.

nodes.name: row_to_entry
nodes.summary: Maps a SQL row to an OutboxEntry domain struct.

nodes.name: row_to_problem
nodes.summary: Maps a SQL row to an OutboxProblemRow for the sync-problems UI.

nodes.name: load_by_id
nodes.summary: Loads a single outbox entry by id.

nodes.name: list_for_project
nodes.summary: Lists outbox entries for a given project slug.

nodes.name: list_problems
nodes.summary: Lists failed/abandoned outbox entries surfaced to the sync-problems UI.

nodes.name: read_adapter_binding
nodes.summary: Reads the adapter binding configuration for a project.

nodes.name: read_sync_cursor
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted pull cursor for a project.

nodes.name: read_last_webhook_at
nodes.summary: Reads the timestamp of the last inbound webhook received for a project.

nodes.name: last_error_for_project
nodes.summary: Reads the most recent sync error recorded for a project.

nodes.name: count_by_status
nodes.summary: Counts outbox entries for a project filtered by status.

nodes.name: list_bound_projects
nodes.summary: Lists every project with an attached sync adapter, used by the pull cycle to know what to poll.

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Inserts a new outbox_entries row and returns it with its assigned id.

nodes.name: record_local_update
nodes.summary: Records a local field-level change as a pending outbox row so the push cycle will sync it outward.

nodes.name: claim_next_pending
nodes.summary: Atomically claims the next pending outbox row for push, moving it to in_flight with a single conditional UPDATE to avoid races between worker ticks.

nodes.name: claim_next_merge_external
nodes.summary: Atomically claims the next merge_external outbox row for the merge cycle.

nodes.name: mark_succeeded
nodes.summary: Marks an outbox row succeeded.

nodes.name: mark_failed_with_backoff
nodes.summary: Marks an outbox row failed, applying the retry-count backoff schedule or abandoning it once retries are exhausted.

nodes.name: reset_in_flight_to_pending
nodes.summary: Recovers orphaned in_flight rows back to pending on worker startup after an unclean shutdown.

nodes.name: gc_succeeded
nodes.summary: Deletes succeeded outbox rows older than a retention window, bounded by a row limit per sweep.

nodes.name: requeue_for_project
nodes.summary: Requeues all abandoned/failed rows for a project back to pending.

nodes.name: requeue_one
nodes.summary: Requeues a single outbox entry back to pending.

nodes.name: discard_one
nodes.summary: Deletes a single outbox entry, used to dismiss a sync problem from the UI.

nodes.name: attach_adapter
nodes.summary: Writes the adapter binding for a project, attaching it to a sync connection.

nodes.name: detach_adapter
nodes.summary: Clears a project's adapter binding.

nodes.name: write_sync_cursor
nodes.summary: Persists the pull cursor for a project after a successful pull.
